title: NR LDPC Decoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/NR_LDPC_Decoder.md
text: Decode LDPC code according to 5G NR standard, 6 inputs, 6 outputs; {Algorithm} sets the type of algorithm, {Scaling factor}, {Decoding termination criteria} sets the termination criteria, {Source for number of iterations} sets the source selection for number of iterations, {Number of iterations}, {Maximum number of iterations}, {Enable multiple code rates} sets the multiple code rates and {Enable parity check output port} sets the parity check status. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Scaling factor 0.75 (default) | values in the range from 0.5 to 1, incremented by 0.0625
